purpose: Make access changes and temporary-password policy authoritative at the authenticated browser-session boundary.
security_boundaries: stale sessions are rejected after Access Profile, scope, status or credential security changes
custom Access Profile permission changes revoke every assigned identity session
temporary-password identities cannot use operational pages or APIs until changing the password
deactivate-reactivate cycles cannot revive a pre-change authenticated session
stale API sessions receive explicit 401 session_revoked and password-change-required APIs receive 428
